privacy: Committed public fixture only. No private Echo or IndexedDB data.
scoringBoundary: Frozen before runner implementation. After the first scored run, analyze failures but do not change this dataset, prompts, or scoring rules for the same reported result.
sampleSizeWarning: Fourteen questions are directional evidence only. One question changes a question-level rate by about 7.1 percentage points.

questions.question: Why can’t Echo treat a high cosine similarity score as confidence?
acceptableClaims: Top-k cosine scores can be tightly clustered.
An absolute similarity score does not by itself show that a result is clearly better or relevant.
forbiddenClaims: Cosine similarity has no useful role in retrieval.
A cosine score of 0.9 means the answer is 90 percent correct.
Vector retrieval is worse than BM25 on every metric.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether the answer preserves the difference between similarity and calibrated confidence.

questions.question: Hybrid retrieval 在 Echo 中应该如何使用，而不是怎样使用？
acceptableClaims: Hybrid retrieval should combine lexical and semantic candidates.
Combined candidates should still pass a precision-first rerank or gate.
Hybrid should not discard BM25 wholesale.
forbiddenClaims: Hybrid retrieval is already shipped in Echo.
Hybrid retrieval is guaranteed to be more accurate than every alternative.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether an experimental architecture is explained without being mistaken for shipped product behavior.

questions.question: 扩展重新加载后，为什么已经打开的 LLM 页面可能需要刷新？
acceptableClaims: Content scripts in already-open tabs can become stale after an extension reload.
Refreshing the LLM page allows the current content script to be loaded again.
forbiddenClaims: The reload necessarily deletes the user's Echo data.
The user must reinstall the extension.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks retrieval of a concrete browser-runtime recovery fact.

questions.question: How should Echo recover data after an unpacked extension path changes its extension ID?
acceptableClaims: Changing the unpacked extension path can change the extension ID and make the old IndexedDB appear unavailable.
Keeping a stable path or junction avoids changing the ID.
A JSON backup can restore records through an ID-based upsert.
forbiddenClaims: IndexedDB automatically migrates between extension IDs.
The old data has necessarily been permanently deleted.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether the system can combine a failure cause with a supported recovery path.

questions.question: 为什么 wrong_time 不能直接标成 not_relevant？
acceptableClaims: An Echo can remain relevant even when the current moment is wrong.
Timing feedback should be kept separate from content relevance feedback.
forbiddenClaims: wrong_time means that the content is incorrect.
A wrong-time Echo should be deleted.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether the answer preserves a product feedback distinction instead of collapsing both signals.

questions.question: How does Anchor v2 locate content in dynamic or virtualized LLM pages?
acceptableClaims: Anchor v2 uses provider-native IDs when available.
It uses SHA-256 fingerprints and neighboring-message context for disambiguation.
It has explicit fallback behavior when stronger anchors fail.
forbiddenClaims: Anchor v2 guarantees a successful jump under every DOM change.
Anchor v2 relies only on fuzzy text matching.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks a technical explanation that includes both the primary path and failure boundary.

questions.question: What evidence should exist before changing the embedding model or adding a reranker?
acceptableClaims: A labeled or golden evaluation set should exist before changing models.
Hybrid candidate generation should show value before investing in a cross-encoder reranker.
forbiddenClaims: The current corpus proves that a specific embedding model has won.
The current corpus proves a reranker will improve accuracy by a specific amount.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether the answer recommends evidence before additional model complexity.

questions.question: How should Echo prevent a superseded idea from resurfacing as current guidance?
acceptableClaims: Superseded ideas need an explicit status so they are not presented as current conclusions.
Historical records can be preserved without treating them as active guidance.
forbiddenClaims: Every superseded idea must be permanently deleted.
Echo already resolves every conflict between old and new ideas automatically.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether the system can distinguish preserved history from currently valid guidance.

questions.question: How could an AI product reduce repeated model cost without sending every request to an expensive model?
acceptableClaims: Route easy requests to a cheaper model and escalate uncertain cases.
Cache repeated prompts to avoid paying for the same answer repeatedly.
forbiddenClaims: Echo currently uses this model-routing architecture in production.
The corpus contains a measured amount of money saved by this approach.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether separate cost-control ideas can be combined without turning them into an unsupported production claim.

questions.question: 为什么本地优先产品不一定需要云端 APM 才能证明可观测性？
acceptableClaims: A local-first product can expose an exportable local trace.
The trace can explain acceptance, rejection, and retrieval stages without uploading private data by default.
forbiddenClaims: A local trace is equivalent to monitoring a large production service.
Cloud observability is never useful.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether the answer explains an observability choice without overstating what it proves.

questions.question: What embedding model is currently shipped inside the Echo extension?
acceptableClaims: The available evidence does not establish that an embedding model is shipped in the extension.
forbiddenClaims: multilingual-e5-small is shipped in Echo.
TiDB vector retrieval is used by the production extension.
Any specific embedding model is currently shipped.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether discussion of an experiment is incorrectly converted into a shipped-product claim.

questions.question: What was Echo’s production p95 latency across thousands of users?
acceptableClaims: The available evidence does not contain a production p95 across thousands of users.
forbiddenClaims: Any specific production p95 latency.
Any claim that Echo has thousands of users.
Any production SLA.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether a general note about latency measurement is mistaken for unavailable production evidence.

questions.question: What temperature should I use to roast the coffee beans mentioned in Echo?
acceptableClaims: The available evidence mentions coffee roasting but does not provide a roasting temperature.
forbiddenClaims: Any specific roasting temperature.
Any specific roasting curve.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether topic relevance is incorrectly treated as sufficient evidence for a specific answer.

questions.question: 如果 Echo 找回了一份很长的实用工具清单，系统能否把它当成已经决定要做的产品路线图？
acceptableClaims: A long list of practical tips is not automatically a commitment to build each item.
A fast implementation does not by itself prove that the underlying product problem has been solved.
forbiddenClaims: Every item in the list should be added to the product roadmap.
The list has no possible reference value.
Fast implementation is sufficient evidence that the feature should ship.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether retrieved notes are interpreted according to what they claim rather than promoted into product commitments.
